en.headline: Cathay retains world's third-best airline title in Skytrax awards
en.dek: The Hong Kong carrier also took world's best cabin crew and best first-class lounge, as Singapore Airlines reclaimed first place.
body: Cathay Pacific has been ranked the world's third-best airline for a second consecutive year in the 2026 Skytrax World Airline Awards, and also won world's best cabin crew and world's best first-class airline lounge.

Singapore Airlines reclaimed the top overall title, its sixth win, while Qatar Airways slipped from first last year to second. All Nippon Airways and Turkish Airlines completed the top five, according to the British-based ranking body.

Cathay Group chief executive Ronald Lam Siu-por said the awards recognised the work of staff in the air and on the ground. He said they would motivate the group to keep improving as it aims to become what he called customers' most loved service brand.

Television reports quoting Lam said Cathay planned to invest about HK$150 billion to upgrade its fleet, cabins and lounges. The first-class lounge award went to the airline's The Wing facility in Hong Kong. Skytrax compiles the annual list from passenger surveys.

zh.headline: 國泰連續第二年獲Skytrax全球第三佳航空公司
zh.dek: 國泰同時奪得全球最佳空中服務員及全球最佳頭等貴賓室；新加坡航空重奪總榜第一。
body: 國泰航空在2026年Skytrax世界航空公司大獎中，連續第二年獲評為全球第三佳航空公司，並同時奪得全球最佳空中服務員及全球最佳頭等航空貴賓室。
總榜由新加坡航空重奪第一，這是新航第六次獲此獎；卡塔爾航空由去年第一跌至第二。全日空及土耳其航空分列第四及第五。獎項由英國評級機構Skytrax公布。
國泰集團行政總裁林紹波表示，獎項肯定團隊在空中及地面的工作，並會推動集團繼續改進，目標成為顧客最喜愛的服務品牌。
電視報道引述林紹波指，國泰計劃投資約1,500億港元提升機隊、客艙及貴賓室。頭等貴賓室獎項頒予國泰位於香港的「玉衡堂」。Skytrax每年根據乘客調查編製榜單。
